minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, March 20, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee Was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, March 20, 2019.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Lorraine Missick, Terry Kistler, Scott Snider,
  Chick Campo and George Borst
  Members absent: Lorraine Missick
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator and Brandon Granillo,
  Recreation Coordinator
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, February 20,
  2019 meeting. Motion carried.
2. Guest Speaker – Henry Sotelo, Community Senior Services.

  Henry introduced a new program available for seniors. The Senior Companion
  Program which offers services for home bound older adults including, respite to
  caregivers, and domestic help. They are currently looking for volunteers to be
  trained for this program. They meet every 2nd Tuesday of the month at the La Verne
  Community Center.

  Unfinished Business

3. Nutrition Report: Average of 35 meals served for the month of February. Also, the
  refrigerator has been serviced for the nutrition program.

4. Bingo Report: February – Beginning balance $4,805, ending balance is $4,563,
  Change (242). The average of players per session was 58. Total Expenses $662.42,
  Paid by check $158.93 Bingo West, $387.49 Speaker system, $116 February Hall
  fee. Total $662.42. New speaker system is working great. Saw some new faces on
  Friday.

5. Meals on Wheels: 43 participants, 645 meals served.

6. Account Balance: $5,839.79
 7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Bridge has not paid for 2 months. Canasta
  paid for the whole year. Senior Pinochle (formerly known as Senior Social Club) has
  not paid for the month of January or February.

8. Mt. Sac Classes: Drawing is going well with 20 students enrolled. All classes overall
  are doing well.

  New Business

9. Upcoming Events:
  Thursday, March 21st – State of the City at Hillcrest
  Wednesday, March 27th – Senior Seminar Series on Stress and Chronic Conditions
  Thursday, March 28th – Variety Show held at the La Verne Community Center
  Monday, April 8th – Movie Matinee at the La Verne Community Center showing 5
  Flights Up
  Thursday, April 17th – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Spring Theme) 11:30 AM
  Saturday, April 20th – Easter Egg Hunt at Las Flores Park & Emerald Park 10:00 AM

10. Facilities Report: Community Center – Restrooms are finished. The sound system
  for the Main Hall has been fixed. A Tri City Navigator will be available from 10:00 AM
  – 8:30 PM to help serve the homeless. Veterans Hall – Fire Marshall Inspection is
  done. Need new locks on doors.

11. Public Comments: Brandon– April 26th, Inter Valley Health Plan will setup and
  serve lunch and help with bingo volunteers.

  Scott – Hillcrest rose over $60,000 at the Good Samaritan Dinner. Also mentioned,
  The Chamber of Commerce Community Yard Sale held on April 13th.

  George – Golf League – still at Sierra La Verne – Currently have 20-24 players and
  there is no additional news on closing. Marshall Canyon has new fairway trails.
  Furthermore, they will be improving cub house and other things.

12. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:00 AM. Motion approved and carried.
  The next meeting will be Wednesday, April 17, 2019 at 10:00 AM.
